title: Apple's Asia suppliers fall on report iPhone XR production boost cancelled
text: Apple's Asia suppliers fall on report iPhone XR production boost cancelled Tuesday, 6 November 2018 ( 2 hours ago ) Apple Inc's Asian supplier and assembler stocks fell on Tuesday on a media report that the iPhone maker had told its smartphone assemblers to halt plans for additional production lines dedicated to its new iPhone XR. ▶ iPhone XR Production Boost Cancelled 00:42 Reuters reports that Apple Inc has told its smartphone assemblers Foxconn and Pegatron to halt plans for additional production lines dedicated to the iPhone XR.
